Utility programs

We made friends with your utility so you don't have to.

Optiwatt partners with utilities across North America to bring energy programs right to your phone. Some pay cash for shifting charging when the grid's crowded. Others are clean-grid initiatives without a payout. All of them, you can join with a tap.

Available across 36 utility programs and growing. Rewards (when offered) come from your utility — Optiwatt just makes them easy to find, join, and actually collect.

  • Cash, credits, or just good karma.

    Some programs have paid drivers up to $650 in cash or bill credits for participating. Others let you help the grid stay clean without a payout. Your utility decides — we just show you what's on the table.

  • Easy mode, on tap.

    Manually apply for programs, or flip on Support My Local Grid and we'll auto-enroll you in everything you qualify for. No portals, no fine-print PDFs.

  • Bail anytime.

    Got a road trip and need a full charge during an event? One tap and you're out. We won't take it personally.

The "what's the catch" section

Wait — it's actually free?

Most "free" apps make money by selling your data or sneaking in a paywall on page four. We don't.

No subscription. No upsell. No "premium tier" hidden three taps in.

01

Utility

Has a problem at 6 PM. When everyone gets home and plugs in at once, the grid strains and utilities have to fire up expensive backup plants. They'd really rather you charged at 2 AM.

02

Optiwatt

Solves it for them. We move charging to off-peak hours automatically. The utility pays us a small fee per car we shift. That's how we make money.

03

You

Get a smaller bill. Off-peak rates are cheaper, so you spend less on charging. The app stays free. Nobody's selling your data. Yes, that's actually the whole pitch.

Common questions

Got questions? We've got answers.

Is Optiwatt really free?

Yes — free, forever. We're paid by utilities to help them shift load away from peak hours, which means the app stays free for you. No subscriptions, no trial periods, no credit card required.

Which EVs does Optiwatt support?

27 vehicle brands, including all Tesla models plus Chevrolet, Hyundai, Kia, Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, Toyota, Lexus, Volvo, and more. We add new makes and models regularly — view our full list of eligible EVs.

How much can I actually save?

The average Optiwatt user saves about $388 a year on EV charging — up to a 70% reduction in charging costs depending on your utility's rates and your driving pattern.

How do utility programs work?

Optiwatt partners with utilities across North America to bring you energy programs. Some pay cash or bill credits — drivers have earned up to $650 from a single program — for participating in demand-response events. Others are clean-grid initiatives without a payout. You can browse eligible programs in the app and enroll one-by-one, or flip on Support My Local Grid to have Optiwatt auto-enroll you in everything you qualify for. Either way, you can opt out of any individual event with one tap, and if your utility doesn't currently offer programs Optiwatt supports, you'll still save through lower-rate charging.

Is Optiwatt secure? Is my data safe?

Optiwatt never stores your vehicle account credentials. When you connect your EV, we receive an encrypted authorization token, and we discard any sensitive data after that. Your data is never sold.

Will my car always be charged when I need it?

Yes. You set your ready-by time, and Optiwatt guarantees your car will hit your target charge level by then.

What is preconditioning?

If you enable preconditioning, Optiwatt automatically warms your battery pack before your scheduled departure to reduce the effects of cold weather. The result: better regenerative braking, more available power, and longer range when you start driving.

Can I stop or pause charging at any time?

Anytime. You can override the schedule and charge immediately from the app, pause the scheduler entirely, or opt out of any demand-response event your utility runs. You're always in control.
